2.5.13 Calculate cameraPR gene set testing across clusters within cell cycle phase per sample

#' Run limma::cameraPR gene set testing for Hallmark gene sets for contrasts of
#' interest on gene lists ranked by quasipoisson Wald statistic between kmeans
#' clusters within a sample within separate called cell cycle phases using the
#' following criteria:
#'
#' for a certain set of comparisons, if the QPglm Wald statistics:
#' are all positive, uses the minimum delta as a marker ranking,
#' are all negative, uses the maximum delta as a marker ranking,
#' are mixed positive and negative, use zero as a marker ranking (noninformative),
#' is NA (phi, rates were zero), we set this to zero, as this indicates no 
#' difference between the clusters (zero is called genewide in this case)
#'
#' @param infile_rds Path of rds with dataframe of Seurat::FoldChanges.
#' @param ddir Processed data directory.
#' @param odir Processed output directory.
#'
#' @returns List of cameraPR outputs for each tested cluster.
run_cameraPR_with_delta_1vrest_contrasts_across_clusters_within_sample_within_phase_quasipoisson_glm_simpleaf <- function(
  infile_waldstats,
  ddir = "data/processed/02-scrnaseq",
  odir = "data/processed/02-scrnaseq"
) {
  prefix <- gsub(".rds", "", basename(infile_waldstats))
  k = as.numeric(gsub(
    "^waldstat-ranked-genes-across-cluster_within-sample-per-phase_genewise-rates-within_kmeans([0-9]+).*",
    "\\1",
    prefix
  ))
  prefix <- gsub(
    "waldstat-ranked-genes-across-cluster_within-sample-per-phase_genewise-rates-within_",
    "",
    prefix
  ) # just to shorten the filename

  ws <- readRDS(infile_waldstats)
  hk <- msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "human", category = "H") # Hallmark gene collection
  phk = split(x = hk$human_gene_symbol, f = hk$gs_name)

  res_list <- purrr::map(c("G1", "G2M", "S"), \(phase) {
    res_list <- 1:k |>
      purrr::map(\(i) {
        if (
          !any(grepl(
            sprintf("waldstat_cluster%s-%s_minus", i, phase),
            colnames(ws)
          ))
        ) {
          # Not enough cells to do that test
          print(sprintf(
            "Not able to test waldstat_cluster%s-%s_minus",
            i,
            phase
          ))
          return()
        } else {
          res <- ws |>
            dplyr::mutate(
              !!sym(sprintf(
                "minmaxzero_delta_waldstat_cluster%s-%s_minus_other",
                i,
                phase
              )) := dplyr::case_when(
                MatrixGenerics::rowMins(as.matrix(dplyr::pick(dplyr::starts_with(sprintf(
                  "waldstat_cluster%s-%s_minus",
                  i,
                  phase
                ))))) >
                  0 ~ MatrixGenerics::rowMins(as.matrix(dplyr::pick(dplyr::starts_with(sprintf(
                  "waldstat_cluster%s-%s_minus",
                  i,
                  phase
                ))))),
                MatrixGenerics::rowMaxs(as.matrix(dplyr::pick(dplyr::starts_with(sprintf(
                  "waldstat_cluster%s-%s_minus",
                  i,
                  phase
                ))))) <
                  0 ~ MatrixGenerics::rowMaxs(as.matrix(dplyr::pick(dplyr::starts_with(sprintf(
                  "waldstat_cluster%s-%s_minus",
                  i,
                  phase
                ))))),
                .default = 0
              )
            ) |>
            dplyr::filter(
              !is.na(
                !!sym(sprintf(
                  "minmaxzero_delta_waldstat_cluster%i-%s_minus_other",
                  i,
                  phase
                ))
              )
            ) |>
            dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(
              !!sym(sprintf(
                "minmaxzero_delta_waldstat_cluster%i-%s_minus_other",
                i,
                phase
              ))
            ))

          # Check that we calculated this delta correctly
          stopifnot(all(
            res |>
              dplyr::select(
                dplyr::starts_with(sprintf(
                  "waldstat_cluster%s-%s_minus",
                  i,
                  phase
                )),
                !!sym(sprintf(
                  "minmaxzero_delta_waldstat_cluster%i-%s_minus_other",
                  i,
                  phase
                ))
              ) |>
              dplyr::filter(
                !!sym(sprintf(
                  "minmaxzero_delta_waldstat_cluster%i-%s_minus_other",
                  i,
                  phase
                )) <
                  0
              ) <
              0
          ))
          stopifnot(all(
            res |>
              dplyr::select(
                dplyr::starts_with(sprintf(
                  "waldstat_cluster%s-%s_minus",
                  i,
                  phase
                )),
                !!sym(sprintf(
                  "minmaxzero_delta_waldstat_cluster%i-%s_minus_other",
                  i,
                  phase
                ))
              ) |>
              dplyr::filter(
                !!sym(sprintf(
                  "minmaxzero_delta_waldstat_cluster%i-%s_minus_other",
                  i,
                  phase
                )) >
                  0
              ) >
              0
          ))

          indexbp = limma::ids2indices(phk, res$gene) # order same as res
          res_camerapr <- limma::cameraPR(
            res |>
              dplyr::pull(
                !!sym(sprintf(
                  "minmaxzero_delta_waldstat_cluster%i-%s_minus_other",
                  i,
                  phase
                ))
              ),
            indexbp
          )
          res_camerapr$N_cells <- res |>
            dplyr::pull(!!sym(sprintf("N_cells_%i:%s", i, phase))) |>
            unique() # For nice labels when plotting in heatmap

          res_camerapr <- res_camerapr |>
            as.data.frame() |>
            tibble::rownames_to_column("gene_set")

          saveRDS(
            res_camerapr,
            file.path(
              ddir,
              sprintf(
                "cameraPR-by-QPglm-minmaxzero-delta-waldstat-cluster%i-%s-minus-other_%s.rds",
                i,
                phase,
                prefix
              )
            )
          )
          saveRDS(
            res,
            file.path(
              ddir,
              sprintf(
                "QPglm-minmaxzero-delta-waldstat-cluster%i-%s-minus-other_%s.rds",
                i,
                phase,
                prefix
              )
            )
          )
          return(res_camerapr)
        }
      })
  })

  return(res_list)
}



2.5.14 Plot cameraPR gene set testing across clusters within cell cycle phase per sample

#' Plot a bubble plot of the gene set testing results for the across clusters
#' (one vs. rest) within a cell cycle phase within sample comparisons.
#'
#' @param infiles Vector of filepaths of gene set testing output RDS files from
#' [run_cameraPR_with_delta_1vrest_contrasts_across_clusters_within_sample_within_phase_quasipoisson_glm_simpleaf()].
#' @param thresh FDR threshold per columns of plot.
#' @param title Plot title.
#' @param suffix Plot suffix to go in output filepath.
#' @param width Plot width (in).
#' @param height Plot height (in).
#' @param ddir Processed data directory.
#' @param odir Processed output directory.
#'
#' @returns ggplot2 object of bubble plot.
plot_cameraPR_with_delta_heatmap_quasipoisson_glm_across_clusters_within_sample_within_phase_simpleaf <- function(
  infiles,
  thresh = 0.10,
  facet_by = NULL,
  width = 6,
  height = 8,
  ddir = "data/processed/02-scrnaseq",
  odir = "data/processed/02-scrnaseq"
) {
  dat <- infiles |>
    purrr::map_dfr(\(x) {
      readRDS(x) |>
        dplyr::mutate(
          sid = gsub(
            "data/processed/02-scrnaseq/cameraPR-by-QPglm-minmaxzero-delta-waldstat-(.*)-minus.*rds",
            "\\1",
            x
          )
        ) |> # extract sample names
        dplyr::mutate(gs_name = gsub("HALLMARK_", "", gene_set)) |>
        tidyr::separate_wider_delim(
          sid,
          delim = "-",
          names = c("Cluster", "Phase"),
          cols_remove = FALSE
        )
    }) |>
    dplyr::relocate(sid) |>
    dplyr::mutate(sid = gsub("-minus-", "_over_", sid)) |> # trims the between-cluster _ over rest names
    dplyr::filter(FDR < thresh) |>
    dplyr::mutate(Direction = factor(Direction, levels = c("Up", "Down")))
  if (nrow(dat) == 0) {
    print("No gene sets passing FDR threshold.")
  }

  gs_rnk <- dat |>
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::group_by(gs_name) |>
    dplyr::mutate(rnk = sum(Direction == "Up") - sum(Direction == "Down")) |>
    dplyr::arrange(rnk, gs_name) |>
    dplyr::distinct(gs_name) |>
    dplyr::pull()

  clustername <- gsub(
    ".*other_(.*)_simpleaf-quant-dds-allsamples_filterqc_.*",
    "\\1",
    basename(infiles[[1]])
  )
  samplename <- gsub(
    ".*other_(.*)_simpleaf-quant-dds-allsamples_filterqc_(.*)_glmpca-umap-kmeans.rds",
    "\\2",
    basename(infiles[[1]])
  )
  title = sprintf(
    "%s\n%s\ncluster-over-rest gene set testing",
    samplename,
    clustername
  )

  (plt <- dat |>
    dplyr::mutate(Phase = factor(Phase, levels = c("S", "G1", "G2M"))) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      sid_name = sprintf("Cluster %s (N=%i)", gsub("cluster", "", sid), N_cells)
    ) |>
    ggplot2::ggplot(aes(
      x = sid_name,
      y = gs_name,
      color = Direction,
      label = NGenes,
      size = FDR
    )) +
    ggplot2::geom_point() +
    ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1)
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
    ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c(col_high, col_low), drop = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::scale_size(trans = "reverse", range = c(.1, 3)) +
    ggplot2::guides(
      colour = ggplot2::guide_legend(order = 1),
      size = ggplot2::guide_legend(order = 2)
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL,
      title = title,
      subtitle = sprintf("%s, %s%% FDR per column", "condition", thresh * 100)
    ) +
    ggplot2::facet_wrap(~Phase, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x"))

  ggsave(
    file.path(
      odir,
      sprintf(
        "cameraPR-by-QPglm-heatmap_%.2f_%s_%s.pdf",
        thresh,
        samplename,
        clustername
      )
    ),
    plt,
    width = width,
    height = height
  )
  ggsave(
    file.path(
      odir,
      sprintf(
        "cameraPR-by-QPglm-heatmap_%.2f_%s_%s.png",
        thresh,
        samplename,
        clustername
      )
    ),
    plt,
    width = width,
    height = height
  )

  return(plt)
}

2.6 Inferred copy number analysis
Note, due to large memory requirements, we recommend running this step on a high-performance computing environment and include sample SLURM submission code and R code and show pre-computed output plots below.

2.6.1 Create gene order table from GTF used for alignment

#' Convert a gtf to a format compatible with Broad's infercnv.
#'
#' Takes the min and max coordinates of each gene in the gtf that was used to
#' run nf-core scrnaseq simpleaf.
#'
#' Removes genes that occur in GTF across multiple chromosomes.
#'
#' @param infile_gtf Path to GTF file used to align scRNAseq samples.
#' @param ddir Processed data directory.
#' @param odir Processed output directory.
make_gene_order_file_simpleaf <- function(
  infile_gtf = "/rafalab/drusso/genomes/refgenie_0.12.1_refgenconf_0.12.2_hg38_tmp/gencode_gtf/hg38.gtf.gz",
  ddir = "data/processed/02-scrnaseq",
  odir = "data/processed/02-scrnaseq"
) {
  d <- data.table::fread(
    infile_gtf,
    skip = 5,
    col.names = c(
      "seqname",
      "source",
      "feature",
      "start",
      "end ",
      "score",
      "strand",
      "frame",
      "attribute"
    )
  )
  out <- d |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      gid = gsub("\"", "", gsub(".*gene_name\ ([^;]*).*", "\\1", attribute))
    ) |> # get gene name
    dplyr::rename(end = `end `) |>
    dplyr::select(gid, seqname, start, end) |>
    dplyr::group_by(gid, seqname) |>
    dplyr::mutate(start = min(start), end = max(end)) |> # span entire gene start to end
    dplyr::ungroup() |>
    dplyr::select(gid, seqname, start, end) |>
    dplyr::distinct()

  # A few genes appear on multiple chromosomes -- filter these out
  multi_genes <- out |>
    dplyr::count(gid) |>
    dplyr::filter(n > 1) |>
    dplyr::pull(gid)
  out <- out |>
    dplyr::filter(!(gid %in% multi_genes))

  readr::write_tsv(out, file.path(ddir, sprintf("hg38_genes_simpleaf.txt")))
  return(out)
}

2.6.2 Run inverCNV

2.6.2.1 Sample R script to run invercnf: R/10-sc-inferCNV.R

library(tidyverse)
library(Seurat)
library(infercnv)

#' Run Broad's infercnv on scRNAseq samples using the Parental sample as the
#' reference.
#'
#' May need to set options(bitmapType='cairo') to get plots to render,
#' plotting moved to plot_infercnv_simpleaf() function below.
#'
#' @param infile_seurat_rds Path to rds of Seurat object of all samples.
#' @param ddir Processed data directory.
#' @param odir Processed output directory.
run_infercnv_simpleaf <- function(
  infile_seurat_rds = "data/processed/02-scrnaseq/simpleaf-quant-dds-allsamples_filterqc.rds",
  ddir = "data/processed/02-scrnaseq",
  odir = "data/processed/02-scrnaseq"
) {
  prefix <- gsub(".rds", "", basename(infile_seurat_rds))
  dds <- readRDS(infile_seurat_rds)
  counts <- LayerData(dds, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")

  meta <- dds@meta.data

  # Gene order txt file created above.
  d <- readr::read_tsv("data/processed/02-scrnaseq/hg38_genes_simpleaf.txt")
  gcts <- d$seqname |> table() |> sort()
  names(gcts[gcts < 10]) # scaffold transcripts

  d <- d |>
    filter(!(seqname %in% c(names(gcts[gcts < 10])))) |>
    mutate(
      seqname = factor(seqname, levels = str_c("chr", c(1:23, "X", "Y", "M")))
    ) |>
    arrange(seqname, start)

  infercnv_obj = CreateInfercnvObject(
    raw_counts_matrix = counts,
    annotations_file = (meta |> select(orig.ident)),
    delim = "\t",
    ref_group_names = c("Parental"),
    gene_order_file = (d |> tibble::column_to_rownames("gid")),
    chr_exclude = c(names(gcts[gcts < 10]))
  )

  out_dir = tempfile()
  infercnv_obj_default = infercnv::run(
    infercnv_obj,
    cutoff = 0.1,
    out_dir = ddir,
    cluster_by_groups = TRUE,
    plot_steps = FALSE,
    denoise = TRUE,
    HMM = FALSE,
    no_plot = TRUE, # can be set to FALSE to generate plot in this step
    no_prelim_plot = TRUE,
    png_res = 60
  )
}

#' Plot inferCNV heatmap.
#'
#' @param infile_infercnv Path to final output file from infercnv.
#' @param ddir Processed data directory.
#' @param odir Processed output directory.
plot_infercnv_simpleaf <- function(
  infile_infercnv = "data/processed/02-scrnaseq/run.final.infercnv_obj",
  ddir = "data/processed/02-scrnaseq",
  odir = "data/processed/02-scrnaseq"
) {
  d <- readRDS(infile_infercnv)
  infercnv::plot_cnv(
    d,
    out_dir = odir,
    obs_title = "Observations (Cells)",
    ref_title = "References (Cells)",
    cluster_by_groups = TRUE,
    x.center = 1,
    x.range = "auto",
    hclust_method = 'ward.D',
    color_safe_pal = FALSE,
    output_filename = "infercnv-simpleaf",
    output_format = "pdf",
    png_res = 300,
    dynamic_resize = 0
  )
}

#' Plot a ridgeplot of inferred copynumber for each gene in a given vector on
#' the inferCNV run on the simpleaf processed scRNAseq samples.
#'
#' @param infile_infercnv Path to rds of infercnv final object results.
#' @param infile_seurat_rds Path to rds of Seurat object used to run infercnv.
#' @param glist Vector of genes to plot.
#' @param width Plot width (in).
#' @param height Plot height (in).
#' @param ddir Processed data directory.
#' @param odir Processed output directory.
plot_ridgeplot_gene_infercnv_simpleaf <- function(
  infile_infercnv = "data/processed/02-scrnaseq/run.final.infercnv_obj",
  infile_seurat_rds = "data/processed/02-scrnaseq/simpleaf-quant-dds-allsamples_filterqc.rds",
  glist = c("RB1"),
  width = 6,
  height = 5,
  ddir = "data/processed/02-scrnaseq",
  odir = "data/processed/02-scrnaseq"
) {
  d <- readRDS(infile_infercnv)

  cnv_data <- d@expr.data |>
    t() |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("bid") |>
    as_tibble()

  prefix <- gsub(".rds", "", basename(infile_seurat_rds))
  dds <- readRDS(infile_seurat_rds)
  meta <- dds@meta.data |>
    tibble::rownames_to_column("bid")

  for (gid in glist) {
    plt <- cnv_data |>
      select(bid, !!sym(gid)) |>
      inner_join(meta, by = "bid") |>
      ggplot(aes(y = orig.ident, x = !!sym(gid), fill = orig.ident)) +
      ggridges::geom_density_ridges(scale = .9, alpha = 1) +
      labs(title = gid, y = NULL, x = "Inferred copy number") +
      theme_bw() +
      scale_y_discrete(limits = rev) +
      scale_fill_manual(name = "Condition", values = pal_orig.ident)
    ggsave(
      file.path(odir, sprintf("infercnv-simpleaf-%s_%s.pdf", gid, prefix)),
      plt,
      width = width,
      height = height
    )
    ggsave(
      file.path(odir, sprintf("infercnv-simpleaf-%s_%s.png", gid, prefix)),
      plt,
      width = width,
      height = height
    )
    print(plt)
  }
}

run_infercnv_simpleaf()
plot_infercnv_simpleaf()
plot_ridgeplot_gene_infercnv_simpleaf()
